policy: References informed taxonomy, adult-size scale, morphology, habitat cues and colour intent only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed. The source is candidate-only and has no geometry or runtime asset.

sources.title: On the species of Japanese atyid shrimps (Decapoda: Caridea) described by William Stimpson (1860)
sources.publisher: Journal of Crustacean Biology / National Museum of Natural History research mirror

sources.title: Amano Shrimp (Caridina multidentata), Okinawa creature reference

referenceGradeRationale: WoRMS and the peer-reviewed Japanese atyid revision anchor the accepted species name, diagnostic morphology and river habitat. The Okinawa institutional account supplies a 3 to 5 cm size range and mottled reddish-brown appearance. Lateral colour and fine appendage detail remain candidate-build questions, so no asset is built or promoted here.
